name: Gout of Steam
body:
School evocation [fire, water]; Level druid 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a mouthful of water)

Range 30 ft.

Area 30-ft. cone

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

You spray burning steam out from your mouth in a 30-foot cone. All creatures in the area must make a Reflex save or take 1d6 fire damage per caster level (maximum 10d6). A successful Reflex save halves the damage.

This steam cannot ignite flammable objects.
